images.caption: Figure 1:Overview of D3D.(a) Drafter training.Target-generated responses supervise blockwise denoising and auxiliary autoregressive prediction. Packed attention shares causal prefix computation while isolating diffusion blocks and allowing bidirectional attention within each block.(b) Progressive layer pruning.Each iteration removes the layer causing the smallest decrease in validation acceptance length, followed by recovery and reevaluation of layer importance. Recovery uses distillation from a fixed unpruned drafter whose output distribution is adjusted toward the supervised token.(c) Asynchronous inference.During target verification, one packed drafter pass prepares successor blocks for alternative rejection outcomes and full acceptance. A branch matching the verified prefix is reused; otherwise, the drafter generates a new block synchronously.

Figure 5:Selective prefilling and sequential speculative decoding with D3D. The same standalone drafter scores prompt chunks for target prefilling and generates candidate blocks for verification. Retained chunks preserve their original order, and the drafter and target maintain separate KV caches.
